title: Marlowe & Finch Home Delivery Service Guarantee: Late Arrival Credit and Missed-Date Refund
content:
Marlowe & Finch Home Delivery gives a service credit when its team arrives late and refunds the base delivery fee when it misses the scheduled date, on the following terms.

## Terms

**(a) Late arrival.** When the team arrives more than the level's late threshold, in minutes, after the end of the arrival window, a late arrival credit of the level's late arrival credit amount is given, once per booking. Where the level's late arrival credit is not applicable, no late arrival credit is given. At every service level the late arrival credit is that level's late arrival credit amount. A late arrival credit is given against the booking rather than against a particular charge.

**(b) Missed date.** When Marlowe & Finch misses the scheduled date, recorded as a failed attempt with the cause Marlowe & Finch missed the date, the base delivery fee is refunded in full, with the credit given for the reason of a missed-date refund, and the rebooking is free.

**(c) One credit per reason.** No credit of the same reason has already been given for the same charge. This is read from the credits already recorded on the booking in the system records, each tied to the charge it credits, before the credit is given.

**(d) Limit.** Credits never exceed the charges billed on the booking.

## The late arrival test

| Arrival relative to the end of the window | Late arrival credit |
|---|---|
| Not more than the late threshold after the end of the window | None |
| More than the late threshold after the end of the window, at a level with a late arrival credit amount | The level's late arrival credit, once per booking |
| More than the late threshold after the end of the window, at a level whose late arrival credit is not applicable | None |

*Hypothetical case, late threshold of 60 minutes, window ending at 13:00:* arrival at 14:00 is 60 minutes after the end and is not more than 60, so no credit; arrival at 14:01 is 61 minutes after, so the credit is given.

## One credit per reason, illustrated (hypothetical booking)

| Charge | Credits already recorded against that charge | Proposed credit | Can it be given? |
|---|---|---|---|
| Base delivery fee | Loyalty discount | Missed-date refund | Yes: a different reason |
| Base delivery fee | Missed-date refund | Missed-date refund | No: same reason, same charge |

## Points of judgement

- **Is a late arrival credit given for each late visit?** It is given once per booking.
- **What does a missed date refund?** The base delivery fee, in full; and the rebooking that follows is free.
- **Can the credits on a booking come to more than its charges?** No. Credits never exceed the charges billed on the booking.
